name: Reply to unanswered Skool posts with an LLM (human-approved)

parameters.content:
## 1️⃣ Trigger & config
Runs every 6h. Edit everything in the **Config** node — the only one you touch.

## 2️⃣ Find unanswered posts
Fresh `auth:login` each run, then `posts:filter` (unanswered, last 24h) via the Skool All-in-One API actor.

## 3️⃣ Filter & draft a reply
Skip your own / short / brand-new posts, then draft an on-brand reply with an LLM (OpenRouter).

## 4️⃣ Notify for review
Send the draft + post link to Telegram. A human reviews and posts it (extend with `posts:createComment` to auto-publish after approval).

## 💬 Reply to unanswered Skool posts (LLM, human-approved)
Find posts with 0 comments, draft an on-brand reply with an LLM, and send it to Telegram for review — so no member question goes unanswered.

**Actor:** https://apify.com/cristiantala/skool-all-in-one-api
**Guide:** https://ctala.github.io/skool-api-docs/recipes/reply-unanswered-posts/

## ⚙️ Setup & configuration

**1. Apify token** — free tier at apify.com → set as the `apifyApi` credential on the 4 Apify nodes.

**2. Edit the `Config` node:**
- `email` / `password` — your Skool admin login
- `groupSlug` — the part after skool.com/
- `selfUserId` — your own Skool user id (so it never replies to your own posts)
- `communityName` / `brandVoice` — used in the LLM prompt
- `llmModel` / `llmApiKey` — OpenRouter model + key (or swap the node for your LLM)
- `telegramChatId` — where drafts are sent

**3. Telegram** — set the `telegramApi` credential (your bot).

**4. Schedule** — runs every 6h; tune to your community's pace.

**5. Test** — click "Test workflow". It drafts replies only for posts older than 1h with no comments.

nodes.notes: Runs every 6h — tune to your community's pace

assignments.name: brandVoice
assignments.value: helpful, concise, founder-to-founder, no corporate fluff

nodes.notes: Fresh auth:login each run — no stored cookies

nodes.name: Get cookies
nodes.notes: Reads cookies from the login run

parameters.customBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ action: "posts:filter", cookies: $json.cookies, groupSlug: $("Config").first().json.groupSlug, params: { unanswered: true, since: $now.minus({hours:24}).toISO(), limit: 50 } }) }}

nodes.name: Filter candidates
nodes.notes: Skip own posts, one-liners, and posts <1h old

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $("Config").first().json.llmModel, messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a helpful community moderator for " + $("Config").first().json.communityName + ". Brand voice: " + $("Config").first().json.brandVoice + ". Draft a reply of at most 2 short paragraphs. Ask a clarifying follow-up if the post is vague. Do not promise things the community cannot deliver. Sound human, not corporate. Plain text only." }, { role: "user", content: "Post title: " + $json.title + "\nPost body: " + $json.content + "\nAuthor: " + $json.authorFirst } ] }) }}
